body: READ-ONLY CANDIDATE BLOCKER at 59f8fd0: SignatureSuite never calls RecallSignature.externalMass. Every test constructs ExternalMassReport directly through report(...), so mutating the production accessor to include unranked in attributed, omit a participant term, swap fields, or return constants leaves all five tests green. The central fix is untested. Add a real RecallSignature fixture with distinct values for all six masses and assert externalMass.attributed is exactly the five-term sum, unranked exactly unrankedMass, rankedMass exact; mutation re-adds unranked and goes red. Also: ExternalMassReport is a public case class, so invalid negative/>1/NaN masses and rankedMass outside [0,1] are constructible, contrary smart-constructor discipline. Finally, the Scaladoc/commit overclaims: sig.externalMass.attributed is a bare Double and can be quoted/serialized without rankedMass, and the typeChecks tripwire only bans two method names, not any sum accessor. The split still prevents the old accidental accessor and is useful, but please narrow the claim and make construction validated/private or justify why this report is only a view over already-validated signature values.
